description: Map any photo's tones to two colors you pick for a striking duotone effect.

faqs.a: Each pixel's brightness is used to blend between your shadow color and your highlight color.
faqs.q: How does the duotone mapping work?

faqs.a: Yes — use the color pickers and the preview updates live.
A lossless PNG at the original dimensions.

howto: Drop an image into the tool.
Pick a shadow color and a highlight color.
Click Download PNG to save it.
title: Image Duotone
